title: Veteran analyst firm resets S&P 500 price target for 2026 - Yahoo Finance
text: Veteran analyst firm resets S&P 500 price target for 2026 Nauman Khan May 9, 2026 1 min read This article first appeared on GuruFocus . RBC Capital Markets said it has raised its 12-month S&P 500 target to 7,900, pointing to expectations of continued earnings support and demand for growth assets, amid resilient corporate earnings trends and improving market sentiment. RBC Capital Markets said the revision is based on its valuation and earnings-per-share model, which it believes reflects a two-speed economic backdrop where some sectors slow while others are supported by consumer spending and artificial intelligence investment, including technology-led growth and artificial intelligence-driven spending themes across sectors. RBC Capital Markets maintained a positive view on U.S. equities versus global markets, citing stronger earnings momentum and continued leadership from large-cap growth companies over value stocks, and noted continued outperformance potential in U.S. markets compared with international peers. RBC Capital Markets said it still sees selective upside in small caps, though it favors larger growth names, and noted a downgrade of health care to market weight in its latest sector allocation update as part of its latest portfolio allocation update for investors in its outlook note.
